title: Beyond Human Judgment: A Bayesian Evaluation of LLMs’ Moral Values Understanding

bias_targets.methodology: Employing a Bayesian annotation competence model (a variant of the Dawid-Skene model) to capture inter-annotator disagreement and estimate annotator reliability. The study measures systematic human conservatism (bias toward under-detecting moral content) by comparing human false negative and false positive rates against AI model predictions.

Tracking and analyzing the rejection rates of input texts by commercial LLM safety filters (such as Azure OpenAI), demonstrating systematic exclusion or refusal to process morally relevant and politically expressive content.
